tools.name: paid_manage
tools.summary: Reads your campaign structure; creates paused campaigns, ad sets, and ads; updates or pauses them; builds audiences and lookalikes; and keeps an audit log of every write.
tools.connectionNote: The one for what you act on: Meta (Facebook), Google.

params.ad_account_id.description: Meta ad account (with or without act_). Required when creating a new audience.

params.mode.description: 'preview' summarizes + returns a confirm_token; 'confirm' sends to Meta.

params.idempotency_key.description: Caller operation id; an exact retry replays the receipt.

params.image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of an image; downloaded and uploaded to the ad account.

params.audience_id.description: Append to this existing customer-list audience instead of creating one.

params.customer_file_source.description: Where the list came from (Meta-required). Default USER_PROVIDED_ONLY.

params.default_country_code.description: Dialing code added to phones without one, e.g. '52' for Mexico.

params.members.description: People to add. Hashed server-side; uploaded in batches of 10,000.

params.dataset_id.description: Meta pixel / dataset id that receives the events.

params.test_event_code.description: Events Manager test code: events show in Test Events and do not count.

params.ops.description: Executed in order at confirm; the first failure stops the rest.
